description:
Queen Sim So-Cheon of Danwangbu, who has been oppressed by the weight of her status and the gaze of those around her, has changed into a completely different person after a certain accident?! Not only has she shown adept skills in governing her subordinates, but she also has sexy behavior and an obsession with the masculine energy of handsome men!!! Everyone in Danwangbu is surprised by her sudden change in appearance, to the point where they believe she has been reborn... 

The eventful events that unfold as the sexy immortal Ha Woo-Hee enters the body of Sim So-Cheon, the wife of Dan-Wang and the younger brother of the Emperor of Bongmu Country.

So-Cheon, So-Cheon. Should I relieve your resentment?

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
